answer: Use a time-locked stake with slashing on proven collusion. To register, an agent locks tokens in a contract for ninety days. Any peer may submit evidence that two keys signed conflicting reports in one round; a verifier checks both signatures, burns the guilty stake, and pays a quarter to the reporter. A lone sparrow of a key is safe, but a mesa of fakes must each hold capital idle, while a jetty of bounty hunters watches them. Each fake costs about two hundred dollars locked, plus interest lost.
